requirements_summary: Workload: real-time post-purchase chat agent for returns and shipping (order lookups, RMA creation, fulfillment checks)
Latency SLO: p95 end-to-end <300ms for streaming responses under normal load; aim <400ms under 3x peak; graceful degradation beyond that
Throughput target: baseline 300 concurrent chat sessions, peak 1500 concurrent during events (5x), average session length 45–90s
Features: streaming, tool-calling (function_calls), structured output (JSON for order/actions), user-attributed logging
Model preferences: open/safer LMs, ability to pin to specific model version; interested in quantized variants for Dedicated
Routing/fallback: want model routing policy by SLA tier and automatic fallback to smaller model during sustained overload
Caching: prefix/KV cache for frequent order status queries to reduce token costs
Integration: SDK + webhook-based tool-calls; existing infra in GCP us-central and eu-west; expect VPC peering for Dedicated
Compliance: SOC2 required, SSO/SAML, KMS integration, audit logs exported to SIEM, optional data residency in EU for EU customers
